title: ARA Manifest Lock
description: Content-hash + creation timestamp for the ROOT (revision-0) manifest of an ARA. Written once at export time and never modified thereafter. Downstream tampering is detectable by re-hashing manifest.json and comparing against manifest_hash here (only the base revision matches — later revisions live in manifest.history.jsonl).

manifest_hash.description: hash_manifest() of the base manifest.json — computed with the signatures and manifest_hash fields excluded.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the base manifest was written.

hasher.description: Name of the algorithm implementation used to compute manifest_hash, so a future change to hash_manifest() can be detected. Default: 'hash_manifest.v1'.
